content.rationale: Both endpoints are prose: the six prerequisites are recorded inline as text and the evaluated decision records, also inline, the consequence those six force. That is the evaluation matrix's natural-to-natural cell, whose form is the gate — the license check, no element of the dependent contradicting its prerequisites — and it is decidable over the record, so it is executed rather than left to a hand reading. The artifact is a stdlib probe, tests/undo_landing/creation_landing.py, which reads nodes/xwoxtupt.json and asks, element by element, what the six prerequisites force: that the created change is gone (prsoxsuo's whole-node removal, qxmzpupt's removal of the created change); that its node document is gone with it (prsoxsuo, with xkolyytz's one change to one node); that the working copy stands at the change the birth was placed after (ytvvzlsp's insertion after a named position, olmoqxzo's position rule, xkolyytz's working copy as some change's tree); that it carries that change's own content (xkolyytz, with zuqzrlrx recording no tree for the working copy); and that the changed/empty shade is read off that beside-change (xkolyytz). Each element is asked in both directions: the record must state it, and any sentence of the record that denies it is a finding quoting that sentence. Assertions are read through phrase families and not through wording, so a rewritten decision that still decides the same landing is accepted — the position change the birth named, the created change's parent, the change immediately before the created change in jj history, and the change the birth was placed after all satisfy the landing element — while a working copy landed on a fresh or newly created empty change, a created change kept or emptied rather than removed, a surviving node document, a working copy always reading empty, a position re-derived at undo time from the graph as it stands, or a working copy composed or copied out of pieces is reported as a contradiction with the prerequisites that force the element. A separate guard reads the subject's own record for the two things its prerequisites do not license: a verdict, since evidence belongs in the session and never in a node, and a mechanism stated in the subject's own voice without naming the node that records it, so the landing cannot become a second, competing statement of the inverse's crossings or of the marker-side state. Each element's expectation is transcribed from a premise phrase that the probe re-reads from the prerequisite's own recorded text, so an amended prerequisite is reported as gate drift, asking for a re-derived expectation rather than for a change to the subject. What the check does not do: it judges nothing in the subject's reasoning beyond contradictions and verdicts, it settles nothing about whether the six prerequisites are right, and it reads no implementation, marker, journal or working-copy state — the landing as behaviour is checked where the undo answer is, by the evaluations covering that answer's edges, not here. It reads the subject and its six prerequisites only: no node resting on this landing is read, so the gate answers for the decision it covers and for nothing built on it.
